column5: GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **Host adapter and component binding logic twice**: `TerminalComponentBinding` (TI/embedding.rs:301-445) and `TerminalInstance` (1364-1603). They differ: only the instance rejects `External` completion slots (1421-1438) and tolerates unbound deferred slots at invoke (1612-1620). **Two scalar admission paths**: 2830 (installation may hold extra supplies) and 2869 (exact equality).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **In engine_calls.rs**: result-kind switch three times (1158-1186, 2974-3000, 3295-3342); receipt-to-claim-transfer twice (1150-1157, 3287-3294); owned whole-place source retirement three ways (170-204, 1552, 3579-3606); scalar-array versus opaque split twice (92-107, 3218-3234); identity-text equality three times (1374-1386, 1775-1787, 2153-2160). The `named(integer-const(N))` string is parsed here and in three other crates (gap 028: grepped, other sites unread).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **In engine_execution.rs**: the six refused register operations are written in the preflight (399-434) and in the run loop (2756-2791); Rflags and fence capability tests likewise (377-398, 2726-2755); `IeeeFloatValue -> FloatMeaning` twice (3271, 3840); integer arithmetic in three forms with separate operand checks (3375-3396, 3621-3695, 3765-3803).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **Float policy across crates**: unit 108 suspected the terminal interpreter re-implements the numerics policy. Gap 029 read the site: trapping calls `FloatSemantics::apply_trapping_policy` (TI/engine_execution.rs:3308); saturating is written inline with an `eligible` operand (3330-3346) rather than calling `apply_saturating_policy` (float_semantics.rs:494).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **Capture, validate, commit against an identity token**: byte buffers (TI/boundary_effects.rs:484-699), scalar loans (2956-3506), storage inputs (TI/boundary_storage_inputs.rs:2613, 2684).

GROUP: Terminal interpreter: | - **Type-graph walks returning a bool**: `requires_materialized_host_custody` (TI/boundary_effects.rs:2615) and `requires_contents` (TI/boundary_inputs.rs:2601), same pattern, different answer sets.
